message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) |
|------------|----------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Salt | 1 teaspoon |
| Eggs | 2 large |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| Vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras** (for richer flavor or texture):
- 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk or sour cream (replaces milk)
- ½ cup (120 ml) coffee (enhances chocolate flavor)
- ½ cup (120 g) melted dark chocolate or chocolate chips (adds depth)

**For frosting** (simple buttercream):
- ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened
- 3–4 cups (360–480 g) powdered sugar, sifted
- ¼ cup (30 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
- ¼–½ cup (60–120 ml) milk or heavy cream
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your preferred sweetness or dietary restrictions. Happy baking!
